findings.category: a11y / non-text state: disclosure state of 'Text version of this image' has no visible indicator
findings.evidence: Lab Value Hacker (bio-02), 1440x900 and 320 px. getComputedStyle(summary): display:flex, ::marker content 'normal', no svg/chevron child (flex summary suppresses the native triangle). The control looks like a titled card, not an expandable section; open/closed is conveyed only by the content appearing below. The accessibility tree is fine (details group, summary); this concerns sighted keyboard/low-vision users who are the audience of the text version.
findings.fix_hint: Add a chevron (rotating on [open]) or '+/-' to the summary, or use display:list-item with a styled ::marker.

findings.category: a11y / live regions: hint text, 'Step N correct' explanation and fragment note are role=status nodes inserted already filled, and focus moves in the same turn
findings.evidence: MutationObserver + focus trace on a fresh student played by keyboard only. Hint: Enter on 'Ask Lab Assistant' -> a new <div role=status>'Hint 1. Inspect the tube...' is inserted (kind region-inserted) and focus goes to the h1 of the question when that was the last hint (button disabled). Correct step: on Fix the Sample, Organ Rescue, Acid-Base, Clinical Detective, 'Step 1 correct. <explanation>' appears (first time region-inserted; later text-changed) while focus is moved to the next step's h1 in the same tick. Fragment found on a non-final step (Master Lab): inserted filled. Hint status does not mention the 15 XP charge; 'Hints used / XP penalty so far' (CASE STATUS) are not live. Only role=alert (wrong answer, Time is up, vault errors: 9 of 9 wrong vault codes re-inserted the alert) is reliable. Announcement could not be verified without a screen reader, hence P3, not P2. Related to known B35-001/B36-002 but a different set of events.
findings.fix_hint: Keep one persistent polite live region per mission screen and write messages into it (hint text + 'cost 15 XP', 'Step 1 correct: ...', 'Fragment 2 found'); do not move focus away in the same turn, or fold the message into the new heading's description.

findings.category: print: mission screen prints with the player header overprinting the content and the selected state unreadable
findings.evidence: Lab Value Hacker with 'Select Potassium result' chosen, details open, page.pdf (A4, media print): the sticky 'Exit mission / CASE FILE / timer' header is rendered in the middle of page 1 and hides the Sodium, Potassium and Chloride rows of the image; in the printed text table the selected button is white-on-white (background not printed), so the selection is invisible. Only @media print rule in the app (refine.css) un-sticks the sidebar (B35-013 family, mission player not covered).
findings.fix_hint: In @media print: .player header {position:static}, button[aria-pressed=true] {outline:2px solid; font-weight:700} and hide Exit/Submit controls.

findings.state_artifact: docs/FACULTY_DEMO_SCRIPT.md section 3 row 1 and 'Dites d'abord l'ouverture de la section 6 (30 secondes, comprise dans la premiere ligne)'
findings.category: demo script timing: row 0:00-0:30 cannot hold what the script asks to say
findings.evidence: Counted from the file: section 6 has 5 bullets = 88 words (about 35 s at 150 wpm, 40 s at 130 wpm) and the row-1 line is 32 words (13-15 s): about 50-55 s of speech inside a 30 s row, while the script says the section 6 opening is 'comprise dans la premiere ligne'. Other rows: speech 10-18 s each, mechanics measured below, so only row 1 is infeasible as written. The script already says the durations are unrehearsed estimates, so P3.
findings.fix_hint: Allow 0:00-0:50 for row 1 (and shorten the later rows, or total 5:20), or cut section 6 to its first two bullets in the 5-minute version and keep the others as slide text.

findings.category: demo script wording: two identical 'Open the Hematology lab' buttons, and the row-6 button is reachable only from the About page
findings.evidence: About page (student) has two buttons named 'Open the Hematology lab' (steps 3 and 4): Playwright strict-mode violation, a presenter reading the script sees two equal choices (both work). Row 6 says 'Open the Progress vault': after row 5 the presenter is inside Fix the Sample (no sidebar), so it costs Exit mission + About & demo guide + Open the Progress vault = 3 clicks, whereas the sidebar 'Progress' is 2 (Exit + Progress). Measured literal route: 5-minute version 22 clicks in 29.3 s of script clock (1.2 s pointing per click, app latency 14-68 ms per action); 7-minute version 27 clicks in 35.9 s. All rows are therefore mechanically achievable; time is dominated by speech.
findings.fix_hint: Name the second button differently or drop it; in row 6 say 'Exit mission, then Progress in the sidebar'.

findings.category: text version: copied table loses the caption wording and carries the 'Choose / Select' column
findings.evidence: Selecting the table and Ctrl+C gives text/plain 'Test\tResult\tReference\tFlag\tChoose / Sodium 139 mmol/L 135 - 145 none Select / Potassium 6.4 mmol/L 3.5 - 5.1 High Select ...'; the caption 'illustrative training image, not a real report' (outside the table by design, B37-004) is not part of the copy, the text/html flavour carries aria-labelledby pointing at an id that does not exist outside the page. A pasted table can therefore look like a real chemistry report. Cosmetic.
findings.fix_hint: Put the caption in a <caption> inside the table and mark the Choose column user-select:none, or accept.
